report.status_line: Nominal operations across habitat systems; awaiting EVA approval for Jan 15 and delivery timeline for static tank resupply.

concerns.title: Static tank resupply schedule and water projections
concerns.detail: The crew was notified by Mission Control at 10:30 that a static tank resupply will take place in the near future, but no clear schedule is established yet. Based on the crew's estimate of ~360 L from 2015-01-13, projected water remaining is 275.16 L (about 3.2 days remaining, running out 2015-01-17) if usage matches the FMARS reference rate of 12.12 L/person/day, or 342.5 L (about 19.6 days remaining, running out 2015-02-02) at the NASA minimum rate of 2.5 L/person/day. To reach mission end on 2015-01-23 (9 days remaining), the daily budget per person is 4.37 L if usage has been typical so far, or 5.44 L if usage has been minimal so far. These figures are projections from a single crew estimate, not physical measurements.

concerns.title: Hot water system inoperative
concerns.detail: The crew reported that hot water has still not been attained in the habitat and requested guidance on additional procedures to restore heating functionality.

concerns.title: ATV 3 and ATV 5 maintenance required
concerns.detail: ATV 3 and ATV 5 require oil level checks and mitigation strategies to return to service, which the crew plans to inspect during the next EVA.

crew_actions: Inspect oil levels on ATV 3 and ATV 5 during the planned EVA on 2015-01-15.
Enforce water conservation targeting a daily budget between 4.37 L and 5.44 L per person per day to reach mission end on 2015-01-23.
Continue standard onboard troubleshooting procedures for the hot water heater.
Monitor the static water tank gauge (steady at 15 cm) and diesel gauge (steady at 75%).

decisions_for_earth.decision: Approve the crew's requested EVA for 2015-01-15.
decisions_for_earth.why: Earth authorization is required for all off-habitat EVAs to ensure crew safety and operational protocols.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Provide a confirmed schedule and delivery date for the static tank water resupply.
decisions_for_earth.why: The crew has 9 days remaining until mission end and projected water reserves run out on 2015-01-17 under typical reference usage.

report.message_to_earth: Status is nominal with habitat operations stable, but water resupply scheduling is unresolved. Mission Control notified the crew at 10:30 that a static tank resupply will occur, while projected water remaining from the crew's ~360 L estimate on 2015-01-13 stands at 275.16 L, which lasts about 3.2 days at typical reference usage. The crew is conserving water and preparing an oil level check on ATV 3 and ATV 5. Diesel remains at 75% and propane is at 40%, but hot water is not attained. Earth approval is requested by tonight for the EVA scheduled on 2015-01-15. Next update will follow tomorrow evening.
